Ravi Desai: flagging a host-side p99 spike after the kernel-packing tweak. short-seq p99 70ms -> 92ms.
Elena Park: which tweak? pack more requests per kernel?
Ravi Desai: yes, PACKER=v3 that packs up to 12 requests. aimed to reduce kernel overhead.
Nina Ortiz: saw anything in perf?
Ravi Desai: small excerpt from perf top:
```
  parse_frame         28.4%
  writev_flush        21.1%
  kv_cache_lookup     11.2%
  tokenize_short      9.3%
```
Syscalls (writev) doubled in the window.
Theo Kim: did streaming-chunker min size change?
Ravi Desai: we lowered min_chunk to 128B for better first-byte latency. combined with tighter packing this produced many small writev bursts.
Elena Park: kv metrics? evictions/hitrate?
Ravi Desai: hitrate fell 0.86 -> 0.69, evictions up ~3x on hot shards.
Nina Ortiz: quick mitigations?
Ravi Desai: tested two canaries: A) rollback pack limit to 4. B) keep pack=12 but set min_chunk=512 and enable writev_coalesce.
perf-bot: canary results after 15m:
- A (less pack): short p99 -10ms, writev -18%, kv_evictions -28%
- B (coalesce+512B): short p99 -17ms, writev -55%, kv_evictions -63%
Theo Kim: B looks best but watch streaming latency for ultra-low-latency clients.
Elena Park: agree. we should add a rollout guard: only enable high-packing when host.writev_rate < 400/s and kv.hitrate > 0.82.
Ravi Desai: implemented guard and added metrics: writev_coalesce_hits, avg_iovec_length, kv_hot_evictions, pack_size_hist. will run staged rollout.
Nina Ortiz: long-term: kernel selector should expose shard_affinity hint so batcher can keep KV locality. Also move kv maintenance to low-priority threadpool.
Ravi Desai: noted. uploading traces + flamegraphs to the ticket. TL;DR: packing improved throughput but amplified host small-write + KV thrash; fix = coalesce + chunk size + affinity guard. :white_check_mark:
